use_cases: Landing page hero text with animated entrance and glitch hover effect
Creative portfolio website headers with text scramble on hover
Interactive section titles for modern web applications
ai_summary: A text component with a glitch effect that animates text scramble on hover, revealing hidden messages character by character. Uses GSAP for smooth entrance animations with scale, opacity, and gradient background reveals. Perfect for creative portfolios, modern landing pages, and any project needing eye-catching animated typography.
